items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-16
items.q: who's maximized that Steve Sung period? I made the first recording.

ctx.x: In the temple. Skip it, you know. What would happen if he had two funerals the same day and the bands met out in the street? Would you have a battle? A jam session? Well, if he don't turn the coffin over there, I mean.

Because I remember the time this guy come out of his trance, and, uh, Jack made those that wasn't even there. Well, I want to ask you something. In all the writing that's been done about you, Pete, sometimes you've been described as a musician, sometimes as a singer, sometimes as entertainer, even a comedian. And you've always had a wonderful relationship with an audience. How would you describe yourself? Would you... As one of them. As entertainer, would you say? I'd describe myself as one of the people sitting…

Um, here's one, Louie. Uh, we know that, uh, we all have to make a living, and, uh, we go to school and learn different professions for it, but, uh, uh, aside from making a living, how do you feel about music?
